You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"<USER> Unable to access my account after you sent email advising that I change my password. Always gives error message "CSRF token invalid". Tried clearing cookies. Can't send you a message via the website because it wants me to log in first. Please advise."

DRAFTED REPLY:
"<USER> Hi! Restart the app by holding down the PS button & selecting Close Application. Then, restart your router & reopen the app. Any better?"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply is irrelevant to the issue and lacks guidance on CSRF token error."}
